remoteTagLimitation: The connected GitHub capability can create branch refs but not tag refs or a Release. The archive branch is mutable, so it is not treated as the sole retained copy.
selfContainedRuntimeSnapshotScope: Execution-critical source, runtime assets, font license, deployment inputs, the original deterministic test, and its art build script.
durabilityBoundary: This checkpoint protects against code regression and a moved archive ref through Git content-addressing, main history, a self-contained snapshot, and a historical deployment. It is not an off-provider backup against deletion of the entire GitHub repository and Vercel project.
